reference_origin: shared accepted detailed reference; no separate business authoring attempt

oracle_runtime.algorithm: Independent datetime parsing of each start/end timestamp, separate endpoint/station hourly counts, then full station_hours calendar iteration and arrivals minus departures; no Loginom outputs used.

license.name: Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD) 2.0
license.attribution: Contains data under the Norwegian licence for Open Government data (NLOD) distributed by Oslo City Bike.

selection.predicate: (start_station_id in S or end_station_id in S) and (started_at in I or ended_at in I)

adaptation: Map started_at/start_station_id and ended_at/end_station_id to start_timestamp/start_station and end_timestamp/end_station; preserve station values as strings.
Add technical trip_id OSLO202401-R plus six-digit one-based original data record number, excluding header; this is not an original trip ID.
Represent +00:00 timestamps as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss UTC, removing the zero offset and fractional seconds without time-zone conversion; required year/month/day/hour remain unchanged.
Derive station_hours as the full 2-station by 48-hour analytical calendar; it does not measure station availability.
limitations: Published anonymous trips of at least one minute during normal opening hours; cancellations and operator relocations are excluded.
No timestamp outside the selected time interval occurs in these nine trips; external station endpoints are present.
The original raw CSV is retained privately; runtime data contains only the two adapted frozen inputs.
source_dataset.endorsement: Adaptation by the eval author; no endorsement by Oslo City Bike is claimed.

publication_note: Local machine paths, instance addresses and session/storage identifiers are omitted. Verification statements describe the original run; private evidence is not included. Public datasets, versions and content hashes are retained.
